verdicts.reason: Both break the design the same way: the dark panel sits empty on the left, while the headline and its gold frame have drifted right onto the busy triangle pattern, which hides the first letters ('rd-Winning / chitecture' in A). Gold text on gold pattern is unreadable and the panel/text pairing is gone. B is fractionally less clipped ('ard-Winning / rchitecture'), so it is very marginally less bad, but both are unusable.
